content: This difference in performances for French and German is potentially related to the need of more significant restructurings while translating from English into German. This is where a more complex del+obj architecture is more helpful. This is especially true for RND and AMB setups where blanked words could also be verbs, the part-of-speech most influenced by word order differences between English and German (see the decreasing complexity of translations for del and del+obj for the example (c) in Figure FIGREF21 ).
